description.en: Checks how many of a player's equipped skills match a given skill-effect type (the player-scoped counterpart to CMND_BTL_GET_SKILL_EFFECTIVE), writing the count back into the 5th argument passed by the caller.
Index of the team/side the player belongs to.
Field position/number of the player to check.
Skill-effect type constant to count (e.g. SKILL_EFF_PLUS_CRITICAL).
Extra parameter passed through to the underlying check.
Output array; its first element is overwritten with the matching-skill count.
Always null — the result is returned by writing into outCount, not via the function's own return value; null is also returned if fewer than 5 arguments were given.
